source: Star_Data/scripts/build_rr_lyrae.py: RR Lyrae stars, distances from Li et al. 2023 (ApJ 944, 88; CC BY 4.0), mean magnitudes from Gaia DR3 vari_rrlyrae (ESA/Gaia/DPAC; Clementini et al. 2023), distance error <= 25%, minus stars in stars_3d.json and cluster members
layout: int16 x,y,z (scene frame, units of pos_unit_ly) for all stars, then uint8 absMag, uint8 B-V, uint8 E(B-V)
